m: सभा f. (of unknown derivation, but probably to be connected with 7. स; ifc. also सभ, n.; cf. Pāṇ. ii, 4, 23 &c., and एक-सभ) an assembly, congregation, meeting, council, public audience, RV. &c. &c.
social party, society, good society (see comp.)
Society (personified as a daughter of Prajāpati), AV.
a place for public meetings, large assembly-room or hall, palace, court of a king or of justice, council-chamber, gambling-house &c., ib.
a house for lodging and accommodating travellers, Mn.; MBh.; &c.; an eating-house (see महा-स्˚).
सभा [cf. Goth. sibja; Germ. sippa, Sippe; Angl.Sax. sibb; Eng. god-sib, gossip.]
a: सभा — [सह भांति अभीष्टनिश्चयार्थमेकत्र यत्र गृहे Tv.] 1 An assembly, a council, conclave; पंडितसभां कारितवाम् Pt. 1; न सा सभा यत्र न संति वृद्धाः H. 1. --2 Company, society, meeting, large number. --3 Council-chamber or hall. --4 A court of justice. --5 A public audience (modern levee). --6 A gambling-house. --7 Any room or place much frequented. --Comp. --आचारः {1} the customs of society. {2} court-manners. --आस्तारः {1} an assistant at an assembly. {2} a member of a society. --उचितः a learned Brāhmaṇa, an educated person. --पतिः, --नायकः {1} the president of a society, chairman. {2} the keeper of a gaminghouse. --पूजा worship or reverence paid to the audience. --सद् m. {1} an assistant at an assembly or meeting. {2} a member of an assembly or meeting. {3} an assessor, a juror.

k.v: वासः कुटी द्वयोः शाला सभा सञ्जवनं त्विदम्. चतुःशालं मुनीनां तु पर्णशालोटजोऽस्त्रियाम्.।
समज्या परिषद्गोष्ठी सभासमितिसंसदः। आस्थानी क्लीबमास्थानं स्त्रीनपुंसकयोः सदः॥
क्षत्रियेऽपि च नाभिर्ना सुरभिर्गवि च स्त्रियाम्. सभा संसदि सभ्ये च त्रिष्वध्यक्षेऽपि वल्लभः॥

a: सभाज् — {c10c} U. (सभाजयति-ते) 1 To salute, pay respects, greet, render homage to, congratulate; स्नेहात्सभाजयितुमेत्य U. 1. 7; Śi. 13. 14; Ś. 5. --2 To honour, worship, respect. --3 To please, gratify. --4 To beautify, adorn, grace; U. 4. 19. --5 To show.

pu॰ saBAyAM sodati--kvip । sAmAjike saBye amaraH tallakzaRamAha yAjYa॰ “SrutADyayanasampannAH DarmajYAH satyavAdinaH । rAjYA saBAsadaH kAryyA ripO mitre ca ye samAH” iti । Srutena mImAMsADyAkaraRAdiSravaRena vewADyayanena ca sampannAH । DarmajYAH satyavAdinaH satyavadanaSIlAH ripO mitre ca samAH dvezarAgaSUnyAH evaMviDA saBAsadaH saBAyAM sadapi yaTA sIdanti taTA dAnamAnasatkArEH rAjYA karttavyAH saByatvena varItavyA ityarTaH । atastezAmupAdeyatvAt svADyAyo'Dyetavyo yUpaM Cinatti purohitastaM prakurvItetyAdivat satyapi karmatve'nuddeSyatvAt tadgatEkatvavadbahutvaM vivakzitam । tacca yadyapi kapiYjalanyAyena tritvamAtreRApi caritArTaM taTApi smftyantaroktabahutvavikalpaparam । taTA ca vfhaspatiH “lokavedajYaDarmajYAH sapta paYca trayo'pi vA । yatropavizwA viprAH syuH sA yajYasadfSI saBA” iti । manunA tu traya evoktAH । “yasmin deSe nizIdanti viprA vedavidastraya” iti । atra triByo'nyUnAH saptaByo'DikASca na kAryyA ityatra tAtparyyaM saNKyAvEzamyantu “BUyo'lpaviroDe BUyasAM syAt saDarmakatvamiti nyAyena vipratipattAvaDikasaNKyAvacanamAdaraRIyaM guRasAmyEH । tadvEzamye tu SatamapyanDAnAnna paSyatIti nyAyena guRavattaravacanameveti pradarSanArTam । “yattu catvAro DarmajYAH parzattrEvidyameva vA । sA brUte yaM sa DarmaH syAdeko vA'DyAtmavittamaH” iti yogISvareRa vizamasaNKyatvamapi bahutvamapi cAnAdftam । tattu pUrvoktAnAM GarmakArakajYApakahetUnAM sandehanirRayavizayaM prakramAt । vyavahAravizaye tu tryavarARAM vizamasaNKyAnAmeva saByatvaM viSezaviDAnAdityavaseyam । ete ca brAhmaRA eva । manuvfhaspatiByAM viprapadopadAnAt । sa tu saByEH sTirEryuktaH prAjYErmOlErdvijottamEH । DarmaSAstrArTakuSalErarTaSAstraviSAradEriti” dvijottamapadasya ca kAtyAyanenopAdAnAt । nAradena “rAjA tu DArmikAn saByAnniyuYjyAt suparIkzitAn । vyavahAraDurAM voQuM ye SaktAH puNgavA iva । DarmaSAstrezu kuSalAH kulInAH satyavAdinaH । samAH SatrO ca mitre ca nfpateH syuH saBAsadaH” iti । vicAryya SreRiBiH kAryyaM kulEryanna vicAritam । gaRESca SreRyavijYAtaM gaRAjYAtaM nfyuktakEH । kulAdimyo'DikAH saByAsteByo'Dyakzo'DikaH kftaH । sarvezAmaDiko rAjA DarmaM yatnena niScitam । uttamADamamaDyAnAM vivAdAnAM vicAraRAt । uparyyupari budDInAYcarantISvarabudDayaH” varRaBedo'nAdftaH । SukranItipariSizwe'pi taTEvoktaM yaTA “yadvarRajo BavedrAjA yojyastadvarRajaH sadA । tadvarRa eva guRinaH prAyaSaH sadBavanti hi । vyavahAravidaH prAjYA vfttaSIlaguRAnvitAH । ripO mitre samA ye ca camajYAH satyavAdinaH । nirAlasA jitakroDakAmaloBAH priyaMvadAH । rAjYA te ca niyojyAH syuH saByAH sarvAsu jAtizu” “rAjA tu DArmikAn
